text: A convenient method for representing the composition of the mixtures, both liquid and vapour,
is to use the concept of mole fraction. For example, if the liquid mixture consists of 0.15 mole
of liquid A and 0.35 mole of liquid B, the mole fraction of A is 0.15 i.e. 0.30.
